intervention: Replace uniform random action choice during epsilon exploration (including warmup) with the fixed categorical distribution; greedy action unchanged. Epsilon schedule unchanged.
derivation: Geometry/catalog only: mean local thrust 990N vs 1500N uniform, weight 981N. Zero-moment probability 0.90 vs 0.50. Symmetric left/right, all eight actions retain positive probability. No PID labels or imitation.
epsilon: Original: warmup 1000; 1 to 0.1 over 80000 steps after warmup; 0.1 from 81000. No reset.
checkpoint_rule: Maximum success fraction on fixed 32 level-1 validation cases, then minimum |x| among successes, then earliest. Initial excluded.
comparison: At 50k compare to previous L1 pilot at equal budget. Beyond 50k, budget is an additional difference; uniform-exploration 100k control with identical manifests/configs is needed for isolation. Original L1 case selection was a degenerate level-choice then uniform index; the prepared flat manifest has the same distribution but not identical reset RNG draws.
evaluation: Initial and every 10000: same 32 L1 validation, greedy/no updates. No original higher-level validation or final test.
decision: No automatic chaining, curriculum promotion, reward change or multi-seed campaign. Training from scratch, maximum100k each, run only after explicit authorization.
predeclared_reporting: Training and greedy validation success, contact velocities/orientation/error, failure causes, gas/duration, signed Q/TD by terminality, gradient norms, fixed-probe and new replay diagnostics, actual exploration action histogram.
interpretation: All 157 successful PID examples outrank each failed behaviour under v1; no v2 created. This exploration prior is a hypothesis, not a validated improvement.
